Child stories created (2026-09-07; all priority 2, tags `complexity-reduction` + `breaking-pass-4`, file impact recorded per pair as base "merge heldout twin" + twin "delete"):

- **S1** — `forgivable-high-whiterhino` (`361f-0a5c-bd12-463b`): merge the 39 `tests/unit/` root pairs (9 renames; `test_plan_material_pin_config_heldout.py` deleted whole). depends_on: E10a-S5 `defectible-befuddling-sheldrake` and every code epic of the release — both escalated (see below). First comment = the 39-row pair table; second comment = enumeration (7).
- **S2** — `cepevorous-garlicky-leopard` (`19c3-0920-8849-49a0`): merge the 22 pairs under `tests/unit/metrics/` (13), `tests/unit/workflow/` (3) and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` (6); 8 renames; the `_clean` autouse key of `test_backend_scalar_surface_heldout.py` buckets `stale`. depends_on: `forgivable-high-whiterhino`. First comment = the 22-row pair table.
- **S3** — `balladic-rutile-oyster` (`fb5f-54fd-96cc-4105`): merge the 17 pairs under `tests/interfaces/` (16) and `tests/integration/` (1); 5 renames. depends_on: `forgivable-high-whiterhino`. First comment = the 17-row pair table.
- **S4** — `frouzy-brattish-muskrat` (`7a7a-ceb9-e9a5-4d8e`): merge the 10 pairs under `tests/scripts/` (7 renames), taking the post-E10a-S3 remainder of the three `test_check_*_heldout.py` modules. depends_on: `forgivable-high-whiterhino`. First comment = the 10-row pair table.
- **S5** — `awake-shoddy-gyrfalcon` (`b721-6c6d-504e-45da`): rename the 78 unpaired held-out modules to drop `_heldout` (the three cross-tier files take `_store`/`_diffing`/`_reconciler`); `test_reconciler_last_pass_heldout.py` carries the E10a-S1-moved tests. depends_on: `cepevorous-garlicky-leopard`, `balladic-rutile-oyster`, `frouzy-brattish-muskrat`. First comment = rename rules + the three cross-tier renames.
